title: Panty & Stocking with Garterbelt
description: Panty and Stocking are obscene angels who were banished from the pearly gates for being foul-mouthed, sex-crazed, sugar-addicted bad girls! Now they spend their days hunting ghosts in the lecherous abyss between Heaven and Earth.

episodes.title: Excretion Without Honor And Humanity; Death Race 2010
episodes.description: Panty gets funky after a twisted trip down the toilet! Later, the Anarchy Sisters must work together to bring a speed demon's reign of terror to a screeching halt!

episodes.title: The Turmoil of the Beehive; Sex and the Daten City
episodes.description: When the Anarchy Sisters go back to school, Panty starts a cat fight with the demonic queen bee of Daten High. Too bad the fallen angel's celebrity status is suddenly squashed by a scandalous home video!

episodes.title: Catfight Club; Pulp Addiction
episodes.description: An argument over heavenly pudding threatens to end the scandalous partnership of Panty and Stocking. In other news, Garter Belt gets backed up when an army of potent demons take over the tissue factory!

episodes.title: The Diet Syndrome; High School Nudical
episodes.description: Demonic cream-filled pastries turn Stocking into the widest of wide loads, and Panty plays naughty when Garter Belt’s lingerie run runs out of lingerie! Poor Brief may never recover.

episodes.title: Raiders of the Nasal Dark; Vomiting Point
episodes.description: Disgusting bodily fluids are the story of the hour when Panty falls hard for a demon with a nostril fetish, and some loser pukes up a wretched vomit monster!

episodes.title: Les Diaboliques
episodes.description: Panty and Stocking are shocked to find their social status plummeting when the demonic duo known as Scanty and Kneesocks try and take over the school!

episodes.title: Trans-homers; The Stripping
episodes.description: Prepare yourself for a battle between the Pantybots and the Stockingcons in this blatant rip-off of a cartoon classic! Next on the agenda, Panty and Stocking trade their clothes for cash!

episodes.title: ....Of the Dead; One Angry Ghost
episodes.description: Panty and Stocking use a wicked assortment of sex toys to eradicate an army of the undead. When the dust settles, the foul-mouthed sisters find themselves on trial for ghost murder with a monkey for an attorney!

episodes.title: If the Angels Wore Swimsuits; Ghost: The Phantom of Daten City
episodes.description: Panty and Stocking take on Scanty and Kneesocks in a scandalous beach volleyball tournament. On the flip side, Stocking falls in love with a super stinky ghost!

episodes.title: InnerBrief; Chuck to the Future
episodes.description: Panty and Stocking shrink down and get swallowed by a boy, Chuck goes on a mind-bending, three-part adventure, and a scandalous music video featuring the Anarchy Sisters rocks the house!

episodes.title: Once upon a time....in Garterbelt; Nothing to Room
episodes.description: Everyone’s favorite foul-mouthed angels sneak into Garter Belt’s secret dungeon and read his diary. For an encore, the scandalous divas sit on the couch and bitch about being hungry!

episodes.title: DC Confidential; Panty + Brief
episodes.description: After an exhilarating rundown of the Anarchy Sisters’ greatest kills, the world grinds to a halt when Stocking returns to heaven, and Panty discovers she’s no longer capable of copulating!

episodes.title: Bitch Girls
episodes.description: Panty must find a way to lose her holy hymen if she wants to keep Brief’s member from unlocking the beast known as Hellmonkey! Too bad Stocking isn’t around to lend a hand.
